transferReady.snapshotHint: Stock is checked when a lot is selected. Confirmation checks it again before sending.
transferReady.cancelActorUnavailable: Cancellation actor is not recorded by the existing workflow
transferReady.title: Stock transfers
transferReady.lifecycle: Requested → Approved → Dispatched → Received · Cancelled or received with discrepancy where applicable
transferReady.bound: Actions retain this transfer’s source, destination and exact lots.
transferReady.branchSwitch: Changing the app branch closes unsent forms. Submitted operations stay saved under their original branch; return there to recover them.
transferReady.balanceUnavailable: No trusted balance is available. This does not mean zero.
transferReady.movementUnavailable: Movement detail is not visible with your current access.
transferReady.awaitingReceipt: Dispatched stock has left the source branch and is awaiting destination receipt.
transferReady.discrepancyFinal: This is a final receipt with a recorded shortage. The existing workflow has no acknowledgement, second receipt or discrepancy-resolution action. Contact your manager to investigate; history is preserved.
transferReady.cannotCancel: Cancellation is unavailable after dispatch. Dispatch and receipt movements remain in history.
transferReady.historyUnavailable: Audit history is unavailable with your current access. Lifecycle timestamps are shown above.
transferReady.batchSearch: Search product, SKU, barcode or lot
transferReady.chooseBranches: Choose source and destination before selecting stock.
transferReady.accepted: Server result found — inspect the recorded result below
transferReady.rejected: Request rejected — no accepted result found
transferReady.recoveryHint: The same operation and quantities are retained. Recovery checks the server first. An uncertain lifecycle action is never blindly sent again.
transferReady.cached: Cached detail — refresh online before taking action.
transferReady.fullApproval: Approval covers the full requested quantity; it does not reserve stock. Dispatch rechecks current eligible stock.

effects.request: Creates a request only. Stock does not move until dispatch.
effects.approve: Approves every requested line in full. No stock movement or reservation is created.
effects.dispatch: Dispatches every approved line in full. Source On hand and Available decrease by the dispatched quantities.
effects.receive: Final receipt: destination On hand increases by the received quantities. Existing reservations and batch safety status determine Available. Any shortage remains recorded.
effects.cancel: Cancels this request before dispatch. No inventory movement is erased.

errors.DESTINATION_BRANCH_INVALID: The destination branch is no longer active. Start a corrected request.
errors.SOURCE_BRANCH_ACCESS_DENIED: You do not have access to the selected source branch.
errors.TRANSFER_READ_FORBIDDEN: You do not have access to this transfer.
errors.INVENTORY_QUANTITY_INVALID: Enter a valid quantity with at most four decimal places. A decimal comma is accepted.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_STOCK: Quantity exceeds the currently transferable stock.
errors.TRANSFER_SOURCE_BATCH_INVALID: Choose an exact batch from the source branch with a trusted stock balance.
errors.TRANSFER_SOURCE_BATCH_NOT_ELIGIBLE: This batch is not eligible: it must be active, unexpired and have available stock.
errors.TRANSFER_LINES_REQUIRED: Add at least one batch line.
errors.TRANSFER_RECEIVED_QUANTITY_INVALID: Received quantity must be between zero and the dispatched quantity.
errors.TRANSFER_DISCREPANCY_REASON_REQUIRED: Give a reason for each shortage.
errors.TRANSFER_BRANCH_CHANGED: The saved operation belongs to different branches. Return to its original context.
errors.TRANSFER_RESULT_UNCERTAIN: The server result is still uncertain. This operation remains saved; refresh history and ask your manager to reconcile it before trying a new action.
errors.TRANSFER_STATE_CHANGED: The transfer state changed. Refresh the detail before continuing.
errors.TRANSFER_NOT_FOUND: This transfer is missing or unavailable with your current access.
errors.TRANSFER_RECEIPT_CHANGED: The server recorded different receipt quantities. Inspect the accepted transfer; this saved intent has not been resubmitted.
errors.TRANSFER_NOT_REQUESTED: Only a requested transfer can be approved.
errors.TRANSFER_NOT_APPROVED: Only an approved transfer can be dispatched.
errors.TRANSFER_NOT_DISPATCHED: Only a dispatched transfer can be received.
errors.TRANSFER_CANNOT_CANCEL: Cancellation is allowed only before dispatch.
errors.TRANSFER_DISPATCH_FORBIDDEN: You cannot dispatch from this source branch.
errors.TRANSFER_RECEIVE_FORBIDDEN: You cannot receive into this destination branch.
errors.TRANSFER_APPROVE_BRANCH_FORBIDDEN: You do not have access to approve this transfer.
errors.TRANSFER_CANCEL_BRANCH_FORBIDDEN: You do not have access to cancel this transfer.
